description: This Java source file implements the ShareProductDividendReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve dividend payout data related to share products. It contains logic for querying a database using JDBC, mapping result sets to data objects, and supports pagination and sorting functionalities.

classes.name: ShareProductDividendReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service interface to read dividend payout data for share products, including SQL query construction, result set mapping, and pagination.

classes.name: ShareProductDividendMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to convert SQL query ResultSet rows into ShareProductDividendPayOutData objects.

methods.name: retriveAll
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of share product dividend payout data filtered by product ID and optional status, supporting sorting and limit/offset parameters.
